name: Mischievous Smite
body:
Drawbacks
Mischievous Smite
Source Divine Anthology pg. 17
Category Religion
Requirement(s) Chaldira Zuzaristan
You consider mischief a sacred rite in humbling enemies. You do not provoke attacks of opportunity when performing a dirty trick combat maneuver while your smite evil bonus applies to combat maneuver checks. If you already do not provoke such attacks of opportunity (such as by having Improved Dirty TrickAPG), you instead gain a +2 trait bonus on dirty trickAPG combat maneuver checks against creatures that are the targets of your smite.
